ApplyOptions.description: ApplyOptions holds the values for the `.distro.apply` section of the config file

DistroCreateOptions.description: DistroCreateOptions holds the values for the `.distro.create` section of the config file

skip_sbom.description: SkipSBOM whether we will scan the images or files

DistroDeployOptions.description: DistroDeployOptions holds the values for the `.distro.deploy` section of the config file

retries.description: Retries how many times we will try to push a package

DistroOptions.description: DistroOptions holds the values for the `.distro` section of the config file

apply.description: ApplyOpts are options used by the apply subcommand

certificate_identity.description: CertificateIdentity required identity claim in the signing certificate

certificate_identity_regexp.description: CertificateIdentityRegexp equired identity claim in the signing certificate, allows usage of regex

certificate_oidc_issuer.description: CertificateOIDCIssuer required OIDC issuer claim in the signing certificate

certificate_oidc_issuer_regexp.description: CertificateOIDCIssuerRegexp required OIDC issuer claim in the signing certificate, allows usage of regex

concurrency.description: Concurrency how many nodes we will try to interact with at a time, 0 means that all nodes will be done at once

create.description: CreateOpts are options used by the create subcommand

deploy.description: DeployOpts are options used by the deploy subcommand

fapolicy.description: FAPolicyd whether we will update hosts with fapolicyd

firewall_update.description: FirewallUpdate whether we will update the host firewall

host_update.description: HostUpdate whether we will update the etc host file

oci_concurrency.description: OCIConcurrency is how many concurrent oci artifacts that will be pushed at a time

output.description: Output the folder that we will create the distro tar balls in

public_key.description: PublicKey path to public key file for validating signed packages

publish.description: PublishOpts are options used by the publish subcommand

reset.description: ResetOptions are options used by the reset subcommand

retry.description: Retry number of retries we will try

trusted_root.description: TrustedRoot path to a Sigstore TrustedRoot JSON

type.description: Type of distro we are interacting with

use_signed_timestamps.description: UseSignedTimestamps verify RFC3161 signed timestamps in the bundle. Auto-enabled when the bundle contains TSA timestamp data.

worker_concurrency.description: WorkerConcurrency number of worker nodes that will be upgraded at once

DistroPublishOptions.description: DistroPublishOptions holds the values for the `.distro.publish` section of the config file

signing_key.description: SigningKey is the path to the private key, a Cosign-supported key provider, used to sign, or re-sign, the package

signing_key_password.description: SigningKeyPassword the password for the private key used for signing

ResetOptions.description: ResetOptions holds the values for the `.distro.reset` section of the config file

description: DistroConfig holds the values for the `.`, or root, section of the config file

distro.description: DistroOpts are various options used by the command

log_format.description: LogFormat how the logs are displayed well running

log_level.description: LogLevel the level of logs that will be displayed

timeout.description: Timeout the longest we will run long ran tasks before failing

tmp_dir.description: TempDirectory the directory where we store stuff before deleting them

zarf_cache.description: CachePath is the folder where oras artifacts are stored
